Welcome to: ADDAC006 ROTARY EXCITER CLAMP USER’S GUIDE

Revision.01 October.2026

DESCRIPTION

These are standalone versions of our ADDAC126 Rotary Exciter, specifically made for guitars using a clamp format to make it easier to attach to any guitar neck. ADDAC006 can be used on any neck from XX to YYmm thick,

It features a 7000 RPM brushless motor that rotates a surface with 2 magnets with opposed magnetic poles inducing a rotating magnetic field that will force the strings to vibrate whenever the rotational speed matches the frequency or harmonics of any of the strings tuning.

A [SPEED] knob allows non-linear control of the motor speed.

Power can be provided from any guitar pedal power adapter, 9v DC 200mA with center negative polarity.

We provide a 5 meter extension power cable to allow a fairly good distance when powering it from a floorboard.

INSTALATION

To install the clamp just place it on the neck and tighten the big screw without over tighten it.
